synopsis.text: The Avengers arrive at the Pentagon, where they to split into teams, one investigating Hank Pym's disappearance, the other going to Slorenia. At Hank's Lab, that team, consisting of Scarlet Witch, Wasp, Wonder Man, and the Vision is attacked by numerous Ultron robots. Wanda is taken out by the Encephalo-ray, followed by the Vision, then Wasp, and finally Wonder Man is overpowered. The other Avengers (Firestar, Black Panther, Thor, and Captain America), arrive in Slorenia as Justice (injured) goes back to Avengers mansion. Lastly, Ultron has gathered the Vision, Wonder Man, Scarlet Witch, Giant-Man, Wasp, and Eric Williams as his family, revealing to make them the 'seeds' of the next race.
